title: Pendulum
overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: Rocky Wake
overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

title: Mascara
overview: After his wife's passing, an old man spends one last night in their home—before bidding an unforgettable farewell. Written & directed by Ahmed Said Ağaoğlu. In development.

title: What We Owe to Each Other
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Brujo
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Ātaahua
overview: A lonely man seeks solace in an art gallery, but instead meets the face of death- Hinenui Te Pō

title: Bleeders
overview: A drug deal with a vampire goes horribly wrong.

title: Toulouse MacDonnell Upcoming project
overview: The story of two detectives in Soho.

title: Starlight & You
overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

title: Nasty
overview: After an injury sidelines Dylan’s ability to train for the Olympics, the determined gymnast must regain the trust of her demanding coach while facing off against a prodigious new competitor threatening to eclipse her place in the spotlight.

title: Honeymoon
overview: When two strangers meet at a seemingly ordinary event, their lives could change forever, as they step into a fairytale romance, with the fragility of their blind love looming above them.

title: Live at Parish Park
overview: On a cool autumn day in a park in Orleans, Massachusetts, local busking fixture Kevin “Coyote” Linnehan gathers friends, acquaintances, and passing strangers to sing and tell stories. Between original songs and covers of old favorites, Kevin revisits his colorful past in the music and arts worlds of the 1970s and ’80s—from “the heart of Boston” to New York and Hollywood. His stories feature familiar names from classic rock lore: Asa Brebner, Andy Pratt, Jonathan Richman, Robin Lane, and Andy Summers. There at Kevin’s invitation is Carol, a photographer and friend from his New York days whom he hasn’t seen in years. The two recall shared adventures, former flames, and youthful ambitions. Kevin also explains how caring for his aging parents brought him to the Cape decades ago—and kept him there. Live at Parish Park is a funny, tender portrait of an artist with plenty to sing about—and an audience that takes neither his stories nor his set list lying down.

title: Jean
overview: Biographical film about the legendary artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, plot TBA.

title: THE INTERVIEW FINALE
overview: Kicking off from a single interview with a fictional character, THE INTERVIEW began as a bit to see how much information AJ Shields could get his hands on. Over a year later, the project has spiraled out of control, sending its creator on a wild goose chase to discover just how far the line can be pushed.

title: Hurricanna
overview: In an attempt to save Anna Nicole Smith's life, her devoted therapist, Khristine embarks on a 36-hour odyssey in which she unknowingly delivers the fatal blow.

title: Cloud Girl
overview: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

title: Citric Acid
overview: A young artist is stalked via the internet by a mysterious online celebrity who harshly criticizes their artwork.

title: Light Pillar
overview: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: Missing Side
overview: Three friends plan to go to a football game together, but a small glitch changes the course of the day. As you move through the city, seemingly ordinary things begin to become unsettling, leaving unanswered questions behind.

title: Best Friend
overview: After a friend is driven Insane and tries to kill his best friend

title: January 12 Vidudala
overview: Two army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy, are very efficient in handling crises situations regarding national defense. When Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters an unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat Reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in the process.

title: Films never learned to die
overview: "Films never learned to die" is a Chilean short film, directed by Iñaki Velasques

title: The Hedonist
overview: After a nervous breakdown, a young office assistant flees to his parents' house in Arizona and hires an escort to take care of him.

title: Children of Blood and Bone
overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

title: The Take
overview: A bank guard, a teller and a master thief play a deadly game of cons and double-crosses.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

title: FING!
overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.

title: River
overview: After the death of their father, three siblings take a boat trip to spread their dad's ashes. However, they discover they have inadvertently stumbled onto the hunting grounds of a strange pair of masked killers, and must fight for their lives on a busted motorboat.

title: The Red Hangar
overview: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

title: The Mirror's Echo
overview: A grieving teen discovers that her deceased twin sister is communicating through her vanity mirror, but the entity reflecting back is far from a sibling.

title: Animals
overview: Still trapped in a doomsday bunker the scientist continues his mission to narrate over footage of the natural world, hoping if animals ever return to this planet they will be cherished.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: The Alone Boy
overview: The Alone Boy is an upcoming drama-action film directed by Resad Ajim, developed as an emotionally driven cinematic project exploring themes of loneliness, ambition, survival, and personal transformation.  The movie is expected to combine emotional storytelling with intense character development, focusing on the struggles of a young individual navigating isolation and conflict in a changing world.  The film centers around a boy whose life is shaped by emotional hardship, betrayal, and the pressure of survival. As the story progresses, the central character faces challenges involving friendship, trust, family struggles, and the pursuit of identity. The narrative is designed to portray the emotional journey of a person attempting to rise above difficult circumstances while confronting inner fears and external obstacles.

title: DISVENTURE CAMP 5 & 6: DOUBLE PREMIERE
overview: The journey on Soluna Island reaches its ultimate showdown as the remaining competitors face one final challenge for the million-dollar prize. With everything on the line, alliances, rivalries, friendships and the lessons learned throughout the season come together in an unforgettable finale, and one competitor will officially join the winners of Disventure Camp. But the adventure doesn't end there. Immediately after the Season 5 finale, Disventure Camp reaches its 100th episode and enters a brand-new era. Fifteen new competitors arrive in the unforgiving Warrakai Outback, where they are divided into three teams based on their minds, strength and charm. With no beds, no fire and no camp waiting for them, survival itself becomes part of the game.

title: Kung Fu Panda 5
overview: Upcoming fifth film in the popular animated franchise, continuing Po’s journey as a spiritual leader. Plot TBA.

title: Iron Boy
overview: 11-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm in rural France. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief.

title: Animal Friends
overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove. As their journey becomes a desperate race to evade capture, the dysfunctional besties must learn to trust in the only family they have left - each other

title: Lords of War
overview: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: Air Bud Returns
overview: 12-year-old Jacob is an aspiring basketball player coping with the recent loss of his father. After he and his mother move to his dad’s childhood home in Fernfield, Jacob discovers a VHS tape of his old man playing basketball on the same court as a hoops-shooting golden retriever. Soon, Jacob begins his own adventure with a neglected golden retriever that he names Buddy.

title: The Panic
overview: New York, 1907. When Charles Barney's scheme to corner the copper market collapses, it triggers a run on the banks that nearly brings down the world economy. J.P. Morgan steps in to rescue the system — while using the crisis to add to his fortune, and facing a personal crisis involving Belle da Costa Greene, the woman who ran his library while passing as white in New York high society.

title: Ultrakill
overview: Two adolescent boys get bullied everyday and record everything. While recording not only do they show themselves being bullied but they also chronicle everythint before they go on a killing spree on their town

title: HOMONOMO
overview: Following a devastating rejection, Ethan (Charlie Walker) discovers a mysterious object  that makes him straight.

title: Night of The Abandoned City
overview: A spin-off from the Abandoned city movie focusing on the mysterious man and his son in the night of the Abandoned city

title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

title: SHEN YUN UNBROKEN: The Battle Beyond the Stage
overview: From humble beginnings, Shen Yun has grown to become one of the most visible and celebrated performing arts companies in the world. It is also one of the most targeted.

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: The Night of Broken Glass
overview: Police Lieutenant Krützfeld faces a momentous decision on the night of November 9, 1938, in Berlin. Following the assassination of a German attaché in Paris, wrongfully labelled a Jewish terrorist attack by Nazi propaganda, he receives the order to attack the Jewish quarter. As chaos erupts, Krützfeld must choose whether to obey the command or protect the innocent.

title: The Rescue
overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

title: Slayground
overview: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth — even if the trail leads straight back to himself.

title: Drag
overview: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

title: Ages of Madness: The Howling of the Jinn
overview: A cosmic horror animated movie.

title: Christmas Angels
overview: During the Christmas season, an unhoused single mother turns to love, play, and imagination to shield her young daughter from the hardship surrounding them, creating moments of wonder in a world that offers them little.
